note: Both sets cover the same four Table 6-2 properties with correct values, units and quotes, and both keep the damping condition (isolated tower, without rotor-nacelle assembly mass). Both also state the 87.6 m height twice (as 'height above ground' and 'overall height'), a duplicate of one fact. Set A adds mild condition tags ('overall', 'undistributed') that are loosely drawn from the surrounding text/table title rather than real operating conditions, but nothing is misbound or misread in either set.
remarks: Both extractions duplicate the 87.6 m height under two attribute names; a single claim with the 'above ground / along tower centerline' condition would suffice. Set A's 'undistributed' condition is really the table's scope label (undistributed tower properties), not a condition on the mass value.
